name: Goblet Squat

instructions.description: Hold a kettlebell close to your chest with elbows angled down and feet about shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and sit down between your hips while keeping your chest lifted.
Allow the elbows to stay close to the torso and keep the whole foot in contact with the ground.
Exhale and stand up by driving through the floor until your hips and knees are fully extended.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a load that allows depth without trunk collapse.

variations.variationDescription: Adds anterior load to the squat pattern, increasing trunk and leg demand.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Remove external load to reduce difficulty.

commentsNotes: Keep the kettlebell close to the chest rather than drifting forward.
Do not force depth if heels lift.
